inverted_analog_transmission.ponder.inve: Controlling rotational speed using Inverted Analog Transmission
Unpowered Inverted Analog Transmissions behave exactly like fully powered Analog Transmissions, so their shaft and cogwheel rotate independently
The cogwheel's RPM scales with redstone strength towards the shaft's RPM
Higher signal strengths result in smaller speed differences
When the cogwheel drives the transmission, the shaft begins at a higher speed and slows down as the Redstone signal increases
At full signal input, the Transmission behaves exactly like an Encased Cogwheel
inverted_analog_transmission.inverted_an: It appears that this _Inverted Analog Transmission_ is attempting to exceed the _maximum rotation speed_. Increase or remove its _Redstone Signal_ to slow it down.
